description: Merge a library entry's latest version into a plugin, in one transaction, and return what was added and replaced per kind. Without `decisions` (safe mode) it previews and applies in one call: every new item is added, nothing is replaced and the rules are kept. `decisions` is an object in the preview's shape: `entryVersion` and `fingerprint` from the preview, and per kind (`skills`, `agents`, `mcpServers`, `files`) the lists `add` and `replace` of `{name}` items (`{path}` for files). A kind without an `add` list adds everything new; a present `add` list, even an empty one, adds exactly its items. `replace` overwrites conflicting items of the plugin and needs `confirmReplace: true`. `rules` is `keep` (default), `append` or `replace`. A whole preview may be passed back as `decisions`: it adds every new item and replaces nothing. A `library_merge_stale` error means the plugin or the entry changed since the preview: repeat the preview and apply with its values. A refusal writes nothing. `decisions.entryId`, when present, must be this entry. `entry` is the entry's exact name (matched case-insensitively, surrounding spaces ignored), or its id with `byId: true`; a value that looks like an id is still taken as a name without `byId`. `plugin` is required and is the plugin's exact, case-sensitive name, or its id with `pluginById: true` (see plugins_list); the installed plugin is never assumed. When `plugin` is the installed plugin, it is then regenerated locally, like `athenode init` without confirmation (the result adds `install` and `regeneration`); if that fails, the backend change is still saved and the tool returns an error. Any other plugin is changed on the server only.

byId.description: `entry` is an entry id, not a name (CLI: --by-id).

decisions.description: Decisions in the preview's shape: {entryVersion, fingerprint, confirmReplace?, skills?, agents?, mcpServers?, files?, rules?}, each kind as {add?: [...], replace?: [...]} and rules one of keep | append | replace (CLI: --decisions). Safe mode if omitted.

entry.description: Library entry name, or its id with byId.

plugin.description: Name of the plugin to act on, or its id with pluginById (CLI: --plugin). Required.

pluginById.description: `plugin` is a plugin id, not a name (CLI: --plugin-by-id).

name: library_merge
title: Merge library entry into plugin
